description: The summer training camp: all of SERIFU/GASSHUKU.BIN (1,587 strings) and SERIFU/GASSH_FU.BIN (1,207, base 0x801B4400; Shiori's camp for every club); game-internals 6x. Pure-punctuation pause lines stay. GASSHUKU's 8 sections (KANGEI.EXN tables at 0x80139A5C): 0 Yuina (Science/Computer), 1 Ayako (Art/Band), 2 Mio (Literature/Drama), 3 Yukari (Tennis), 4 Nozomi (Swimming), 5 Saki (Baseball/Soccer), 6 the shared arrival, last-day bath and technique box, 7 Yumi. Each girl has a first meeting (food poisoning, the test of courage, fainting at practice) and chats by mood and club level through the years. The 'strings' entries translate KANGEI.EXN's camp banners (Camp, Lobby, the club rooms, Ghosts, Peep) and two fixed-record tables the technique box inserts: club names ('slot' 20) and technique names ('slot' 21). Verified in DuckStation on forced camps (force_camp.py via xmas_run.ps1, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'The training camp'): the first meetings of Ayako (test of courage), Yukari (fainting), Nozomi; chats of Yuina (Science), Mio (Literature), Saki (Baseball), Yumi (Basketball), Shiori (Drama, Soccer); the bath with all three windows and both choices; each camp ends normally and the week continues. Checked only statically: the other chats and moods, later years' and club-level variants, the rumors ('studying in Vienna' etc.), Saki's 'missed Koshien' lines, the technique box (not reached), natural triggers.
